{{Top|leg}}
'''Full-range scanners''' were finely tuned [[Sensor/Legends|scanners]], capable of provide accurate readings about a patient.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref> It was a component of the [[broad-spectrum sensor suite]] used in [[Athakam Medtech/Legends|Athakam]]/[[Rhinnal State Medical Academy|RSMA]]'s [[Bioscan Unit]] alongside a [[medtox detector]], a [[vapro-sampler]], and a [[doppraymagno scanner]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
